## Summary

Describe the behavior changed by this pull request.

## Validation

- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make build`
- [ ] Swagger was regenerated when the API changed

## Release title

Use a Conventional Commit title matching the branch type, for example:

- `feat(auth): add Google sign-in`
- `fix(projects): avoid duplicate requests`
- `chore(deps): update dependencies`
- `feat(api)!: replace the authentication contract`
